BacktestCandlesDto.description: Response for the run candles endpoint: the OHLC series plus a source hint.

source.description:
`candles_5s` when the run window is covered, `none` for the degraded
timeline-only view (no OHLC background available).

BacktestErrorBody.description: JSON error body for the backtest endpoints.

requested.description: Echoes the requested row count for `too_many_rows`.

BacktestMetricsDto.description:
Recomputed performance metrics for a run (from `fills_backtest`, §5 recipe).

PnL/fees are cash-flow figures derived from the per-side aggregates; see
[`domain::backtest::BacktestMetrics`] for the exact definition and the
flat-position caveat. Money fields are quote-currency `f64` at this boundary.

status.description: Raw status string (free text — `orders_backtest.status` has no `CHECK`).

BacktestRunDetailDto.description: A run with its opaque configuration snapshot (detail view).

BacktestRunSummaryDto.description: Summary of a backtest run (list item).

data_range_end.description: Exclusive end of the replayed market window (RFC3339, market clock).

data_range_start.description: Inclusive start of the replayed market window (RFC3339, market clock).

ended_at.description: Wall-clock time the run ended; absent while `status = running`.

error.description: Failure description when `status = failed`; absent otherwise.

fee_binance_bps.description: Simulated Binance taker fee in basis points.

fee_kraken_bps.description: Simulated Kraken taker fee in basis points.

strategy_id.description: Optional synthetic strategy id (nullable, no FK).

CandleDto.description:
HTTP DTO returned in the JSON array.

We deliberately down-cast `Decimal` → `f64` at the serialisation boundary:
Lightweight Charts requires JS numbers, and the relative error introduced
(worst case ≈ 2.2e-16 for typical OHLC magnitudes) is invisible at chart
pixel resolution. The full-precision `Decimal` stays in the domain and the
persistence layer — only this struct loses precision, and it is the only
place that does.

v.description: Total traded volume in the bucket.

CandleErrorBody.description: JSON error body returned on 4xx / 5xx by the candles endpoint.

max.description: Maximum bucket count accepted by the endpoint for `too_many_points`.

requested.description: Echoes the caller-supplied bucket count for `too_many_points`.

DecisionDto.description: One strategy decision (marker + optional context snapshot).

orders_count.description: Number of orders emitted by this decision.

reason.description: Free-text rationale recorded by the strategy engine.

snapshot.description: Opaque market-context snapshot (`jsonb`); absent when no context recorded.

fee_asset.description: Asset the fee was charged in.
Asset the fee was charged in.

is_paper.description: Whether this fill is paper trading.

OrderDto.description:
HTTP DTO returned in the JSON array for the orders endpoint.

`Decimal -> f64` happens at this boundary only (see candles handler
rationale). For OHLC magnitudes the worst-case relative error
(~2.2e-16) is invisible at chart pixel resolution; the full-precision
`Decimal` stays in the domain and persistence layers.

created_at.description: Wall-clock time the row was inserted (RFC3339).

price.description:
Best-effort price: `COALESCE(limit_price, expected_price)`.

- For `limit` / `amend` orders, this is the explicit limit price.
- For `market` orders, this is the `expected_price` recorded by the
  strategy engine just before submission, when available.
- `null` when neither is known (e.g. `market` without expected price).

OrderErrorBody.description: JSON error body returned on 4xx / 5xx by the orders endpoint.

allowed.description:
Whitelisted `side` values, surfaced for `invalid_side` (currently
unused — the handler does not parse `side` from input, but kept for
schema symmetry with the candles error body).

max.description: Maximum row count accepted by the endpoint for `too_many_rows`.

requested.description: Echoes the caller-supplied row count for `too_many_rows`.

enabled_live.description: Whether the strategy is enabled for live trading.

enabled_paper.description: Whether the strategy is enabled for paper trading.

StrategyErrorBody.description: JSON error body for the strategy endpoints.

requested.description: Echoes the requested row count for `too_many_rows`.
